notes.title: 2.0 Beta 3
notes.content:
[h2]⚙️ General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed using Rage during warmup.  
[*] Removed Rage in [b]Survivor[/b] mode.  
[*] Removed the old-style menus bound to [b]M[/b] and [b]B[/b].  
[*] Improved the automatic game mode launch system.  
[*] Removed the Rage rune.  
[*] Improved the map voting algorithm and fixed visual glitches.  
[*] Daily missions are now hidden from the main interface once completed.  
[*] Adjusted the rune interface.  
[*] When using [b]ADS[/b] with weapons, accuracy is no longer available until most of the animation is completed.  
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented purchasing points when having the exact amount of Carnage credits.  
[*] Fixed an issue where playtime was not being saved correctly.  
[/list]

[h2]🕹️ Specific Modes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Round duration now scales with kills:  
   [list]  
   [*] Start: [b]30 seconds[/b].  
   [*] +20 seconds per kill.  
   [*] Maximum: [b]60 seconds[/b].  
   [*] Affects: [b]Killer / Synapsis / Assassin / Daylight Assassin / Armageddon[/b].  
   [/list]
[/list]

[h2]🆕 New Mode: [b]Chipansis[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Number of killers: [b]3[/b].  
[*] Killers do not have [b]RPGs[/b].  
[*] Wooden planks and laser mines cannot be placed.  
[*] Every 5 human kills as a killer → you return to human and gain [b]1 event point[/b] (if active).  
[*] Each killer eliminated grants [b]1 event point[/b].  
[/list]

[h2]🗺️ Maps[/h2]

[b]Boxcolors[/b]  
[list]
[*] Reduced the size of the upper base with 3 pipes.  
[*] Added more convenient supports for placing planks on the 3-pipe base.  
[*] Removed collisions on certain tall signs.  
[*] Adjusted the position of the dark sign.  
[/list]

[b]Abandoned Village[/b]  
[list]
[*] Fixed collision issues.  
[*] Improved some bases.  
[*] Added more ladders to access additional rooftops.  
[/list]

[b]Azkin Dungeon[/b]  
[list]
[*] Collision adjustments.  
[*] Improvements to some bases.  
[*] Adjusted doors for better accessibility.  
[/list]

notes.title: 2.0 Beta 2
notes.content:
[p][b]Campaign: Astra[/b]
A new progression system similar to the Battle Pass, called campaigns, has been added. The current campaign, Astra, consists of 5 levels, which are progressed in the same way as the battle pass. Each level has significant rewards, with the final level granting a new human skin called Astra.[/p][p]The Astra campaign ends in 1 month, and it will not be possible to obtain Astra in the future. We consider the Astra campaign a good reward in appreciation of those who play during the current beta.
[url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/7409fac995c2bd8b23d6322a209672520b4b197f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/9f3df64c9aa13675b8c79935b75978800adac0f5.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p][b]Movement[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the max speed that can be reached with bunny hops[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the speed that is added during air strafes[/p][/*][*][p]Now when you stop moving, the character brakes more smoothly[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bots[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slight improvements were made to the bot's artificial intelligence, especially related to jumping. We have planned more in-depth improvements for future updates.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented granting AP upon killing or infecting.[/p][/*][*][p]The character will no longer lose their equipped weapon upon resetting.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the armor extra item in Extermination / Killer / Plague / Synapsis modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed bots in Annihilation / Infection / Multiple Infection modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage mitigation of zombie protections (includes First Zombie).[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the maximum sensitivity in the settings from 10 to 25.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Plague Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Assigned a specific survivor class for the mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Survivor's damage and health.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the Killer's damage when attacking the Survivor.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2.0 Beta
notes.content:
[p][b]Unification of Worlds[/b]
Bloodhell and Nightmare were unified, so all characters can now play together. To compensate for the difference in difficulty, the number of resets for Bloodhell characters has been multiplied by 15.[/p][p][b]2.0 Beta and 2.0 Final[/b]
A large amount of content was left out of version 2.0 beta, along with fixes and adjustments. We plan to add and modify at a very fast pace in the coming weeks, prioritizing what users communicate to us.[/p][p][b]Skins on the Steam Market[/b]
In the future (not before 6 months), we plan to integrate the Steam Community Market. This will allow buying, selling, and trading Zombie Carnage 2 skins.[/p][p][b]Changelog[/b][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Automatic events system[/p][/*][*][p]Gold upgrade “Brain Soup 2”: reduced from 45% to 25% and the maximum limit of 1,000 resets removed[/p][/*][*][p]New option in the key menu to configure which key activates zombie rage[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Graphics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved fog quality. Applied to Hangar and MothersTank maps, and will later be applied to others[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Anti-Aliasing to reduce ghosting[/p][/*][*][p]Increased resolution of various textures[/p][/*][*][p]Added lighting effects for player glow[/p][/*][*][p]Modified Night Vision[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Interface[/b][/p][list][*][p]New “vault” section in inventory where you can view and open all available crates[/p][/*][*][p]New character status interface: includes avatar, health/armor bars, rage, and more[/p][/*][*][p]Indicator in the “C” panel for VIP users, showing remaining time[/p][/*][*][p]In the weapons inventory, locked weapons will now show a crafting icon if they can be obtained through skin fragments[/p][/*][*][p]New Battle Pass interface with updated visuals and images[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sounds[/b][/p][list][*][p]New footsteps sound for the Killer[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Waves Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the number of bots[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards updated[/p][/*][*][p]Bot speed and health reduced[/p][/*][*][p]A specific human class will be used for this mode (mode-specific stats instead of personal stats)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Extermination Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bot speed and health reduced[/p][/*][*][p]A specific human class will be used for this mode (mode-specific stats instead of personal stats)[/p][/*][*][p]Mode duration reduced from 4 to 3 minutes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p]BoxColors: added support for Extermination mode[/p][/*][*][p]Hangar: updated fog and lighting[/p][/*][*][p]MothersTank: updated fog[/p][/*][/list]

[b]Extermination Mode[/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced bot health
[*] Reduced chance of bot killer generation
[/list]

[b]The Waves Mode[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased player health from 350 to 500
[*] Reduced total number of waves from 10 to 5
[*] Readjusted the number of bots during the wave
[*] Decreased zombie speed
[*] Removed the level system and mandatory weapons
[*] Health regeneration every 6 kills
[*] Added more types of zombies during the mode
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Events[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated the way to earn points in annihilation mode
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]

[list]
[*] Reactivated bullet impact on corpses
[*] Improved AP gain when using rapid-fire weapons
[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] 
[*] Modified the login and character selection system, in preparation for a new start menu.
[*] Implemented the acquisition of Iris.
[*] Implemented the Exchange Points system (activated by the C key).
[*] Implemented the best player of the round system (top damage, kills, etc.).
[/list]

[h1]Event[/h1]

[list]
[*] Event modes menu where only those with event support appear.
[*] Support for Survivor and Payload modes.
[*] Messages in different colors during the event.
[*] Added missing translations.
[*] New interface when scoring a point + sound.
[*] Interface showing remaining time to enable points.
[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the 60-minute mission reward to match that of ZC1.
[*] Added missing personal stats from the round (Infections / Kills / Iris).
[*] Increased damage of the survivor in Plague mode.
[*] Improved the jump height of the killer after performing a long jump.
[*] Reduced the spawn height of gifts.
[*] Replaced the font type of the current mode information interface in the top left corner.
[*] Now allows the redemption of APs, HP, ZP, GP codes (previously only for CC).
[*] Night vision was also added to the letter indicators.
[*] Enabled APs in missions for people with more than 1,000 Resets.
[*] Fixed visual bugs in the weapon skins inventory.
[/list]

[h1]Admin[/h1]

[list]
[*] New command to switch people to spectator mode.
[*] New admin action menu from the score marker.
[/list]

[b]Added Runes[/b]
During certain modes, runes (represented by a glowing sphere) will spawn. Zombies can pick these up to gain a temporary powerup.

[b]Improved AI[/b]
Small tweaks and improvements to the bot's AI  to make them smarter.

[b]Missions HUD[/b]
Added option to show available missions on the HUD.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
Fixed flickering of the scoreboard.

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.content:
[h2]New Battle Pass[/h2]

We have added a new Battle Pass system consisting of 40 levels. For this month only, all rewards will be free. In future Battle Passes, some level rewards will be free, while others will be exclusive to those who purchased the Battle Pass.

You can level up the Battle Pass by playing rounds or completing missions that grant Battle Pass XP. We'll add new missions weekly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/0450a9c6c2b04ab460ed874adf77489239fbd005.png[/img]
[h2]Easter Event[/h2]

By collecting easter eggs, you will be able to unlock two exclusive weapon skins: Easter Fire Rifle / Easter Frost Rifle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/5e14046a029427b33210f13b6cd0eb715a5a1349.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Map Vote[/h2]

Now, after the last round ends, a new user interface will allow players to vote for the next map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/326e555444e0377b2f7608d0ad6d0b2fd2231847.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Mission Types[/h2]

We've added a few new mission types, including winning a Tic Tac Toe mini-game hidden in some parts of the maps.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

We've increased AP rewards for Human and Zombie for the Bloodhell world

[list]
[*] Added "Featured" tab to missions
[*] Fix zombies hearing the zombie hitmarker when damaged by humans
[*] Slightly increased zombie hitmarker volume
[*] Increase killer crouched speed and manoeuvrability in air
[*] Increase assassin crouched speed, decrease acceleration, decreased speed
[*] Prevent double jump when crouched and long jump is available
[*] Turn on flashlight on players second chance during Assassin mode
[*] Fixed event system granting points in unsupported event
[/list]

[list]
[*] New HUD when aiming at something replaces the old text version. It includes an animated health bar, and more clear information
[*] Changed zombie impacts sounds
[*] Changed zombie impacts decals
[*] Added zombie hitmarker sound when health is damaged
[*] Now the victim can hear the health and armor hitmarker
[*] Adjusted the volume of different sounds that were either too high or too low
[*] Fixed incorrect sound occlusion in certain cases (mostly related to lasermines and wood planks)
[*] Changed default volume when installing the game (75% master, 25% voice)
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Added bots to the start of the round to infection modes
[*] New players (0rr, lvl <150) have a second chance in certain modes
[*] Fixed bug with melee hit detection that made hits harder to land than intended
[*] Reduced Fire/Frost rifle damage by 5%
[/list]

[b]Visual[/b]
[list]
[*] Added tracer ammunition effect to weapons
[*] Improved CM200/Magnum headshot effect
[*] Slightly changed blood color
[*] Small tweaks to HyperNova animations
[*] Increased impulse in the direction of the shot when an enemy is killed
[*] Added dismemberment effect to Killer death
[/list]

[list]
[*] New login, signup and character select screen
[*] Preliminary support for events system (nightmare)
[/list]

[b]OldwardTown[/b]

[/list]

[/list]

[b]Weapon skins[/b]

[*] Micro Uzi Red & Blue
[*] XenTech 8 Sky

[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]

[*] Plague: Slightly increased zombie health

notes.title: Update 1.13.0
notes.content:
[h1]Nilan[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/dc2d9d3f3295e3b50e0cc74dee20c1ddc71aede0.jpg[/img]
Our latest map, situated in the middle east, is now available to play!

[h1]Human Skins[/h1]
We have introduced preliminary support for Human Skins. The UI and system aren't fully finished yet, but we wanted to give you an early access to this feature.

In addition, we will be giving 3 exclusive human skins as a reward for players that have been with us for a long time. These skins will not be able to be obtained by any means in the future. The only way to get them is to meet the following requirements:

Carl Legacy: Have played at least once
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/f8a777c28ad3572d908af5d7e1dd037dd8d335b9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/5746c65325fb8c4e342d184c7f838529289d0761.png[/img][/url]
Jake Legacy: Have at least 1 reset
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/08fa093f712877857e27195c21c49d95d4f8c914.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/cedb8bf774993e787375033f2bb69d2805bb8b3e.png[/img][/url]
Rick Legacy: Have at least 10 resets
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/ec15d4d9c264dea6a2622e84e955808c69d61aa0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410131/7ab58a6c3c1e3a7360a29e3e4bdda36005f338fa.png[/img][/url]

[b]You have until 2022-12-14 23:59 UTC to meet these requirements.[/b]. If by that date you've met the requirements for some or all of those skins, they will be given to you. After that, it will not be possible to obtain these skins.

[b]Balance changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed human and zombie damage upgrades, human and zombie HP upgrades to reduce the difference between a new character and a maxed out character
[*] Other balance changes to many modes to make up for the upgrade changes
[/list]

[b]Weapon changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased Fire and Frost rifle damage by 5%
[*] Increased infinite mags cost by 66%
[*] Modified base magazine sizes
[*] AK74U 30 -> 45
[*] MicroUzi 32 -> 40
[*] XenTech 8 40 -> 50
[*] AK47 30 -> 45
[*] SVD Dragunov 10 -> 20
[*] MT7 40 -> 45
[*] M416 40 -> 50
[*] Para90S 50 -> 60
[*] M4A1 25 -> 40
[*] SKS 14 -> 25
[*] Skarlett H 30 -> 45
[*] MT5K 30 -> 40
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now hold the + button to increase upgrades
[*] Don't allow vaulting when frozen
[*] Removed clutter in Azkin Dungeon
[*] Changed collision of a lamp post in Mothers Tank
[*] Fixed bugs and improved localization to the following elements: Leaderboards, player report, server list, code redeem, CC purchase
[/list]

[b]Netcode improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon switching should now be instant (regardless of ping)
[*] Reloading should now be unaffected by latency
[*] Spectators now correctly see the ammo and other weapon info
[*] Fix a bug that caused spectators to sometimes not play reload animation
[*] Optimizations to reduce network usage
[*] Bug fixes related to dropping weapons
[/list]

[b]Netcode[/b]
Improved netcode to reduce rubberbanding when changing weapons, vaulting, crouching and more

[b]New Matchmaking[/b]
Now when you press play, the game will automatically join a server based on player count and latency. You can still use the server list to manually join.

notes.title: North America Region Lock
notes.content:
We were having a bit of trouble with players from any region joining servers from any other region. This resulted in a negative experience because of high latency and language barriers.

As a temporary solution, now only players from the US and Canada will be able to join North America servers. Players from other countries will not see these servers in the server list.

We may take additional measures with other regions in the future.

notes.title: Zombie Carnage 2 Roadmap
notes.content:
Thanks to everybody that played Zombie Carnage 2 on release!

I want to briefly outline our short term roadmap, and mention a bit of what we're working on.

[h3]Coming over the next few days[/h3]
[list]
[*] Important bug fixes as they appear
[*] Balance changes (difficulty, health, damage, etc)
[*] Important map fixes
[*] Dedicated Spanish (Spain) and Spanish (Latam) locales. Other locales will be coming in a few months.
[/list]

[h3]Coming very soon (~2 weeks)[/h3]
[list]
[*]Weapon and character skins: This was supposed to land on release but got delayed unfortunately
[*]New map: We have a couple of maps almost ready that will be landing very soon
[*]Optimization improvements: We're very focused on great performance and there are some big changes that didn't make it in time. Some specific modes have a big toll on both client and server performance, and we're working to fix it.
[/list]


[h3]Coming soon (1-2 months)[/h3]
[list]
[*] New weapons and attachments
[*] New zombie classes with new game mechanics
[*] Additional content
[/list]

This is not an exhaustive list, and many more changes will be included.

Thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: Zombie Carnage 2 Release Date
notes.content:
Zombie Carnage 2 will be releasing on the 3rd of February at 22:00 UTC (Check event info to see it in your local timezone). We had originally planned to release on the 27th of January but we found some last minute bugs that we wanted to fix before release. 

Thanks for your patience!
